prompt.en: who did not come to see the jade emperor?
prompt.zh: 谁没有来拜见玉皇大帝？

answer_evidence.quote: "The Dragon King of the Eastern Sea is here to see you."
The Dragon King entered and bowed.
"The Judge of the Dead would like to speak with you, Your Majesty."
The judge came in and bowed.
"A monkey named Sun Wukong crossed out his name in the Directory. I beg you to punish him!"

sources.file: G:\Game\BookPlay书戏\data\测试题\08 英文测试题108集全.Journey to the West-quiz.pdf

prompt.en: why did the jade emperor want to punish wukong?
prompt.zh: 玉皇为什么要惩罚悟空？

choices.en: he took his job very seriously.
choices.zh: 他对他的工作非常认真。

answer_evidence.quote: "A monkey named Sun Wukong crossed out his name in the Directory. I beg you to punish him!"
The Jade Emperor rubbed his chin.
"Who is this Sun Wukong? And how did he become so powerful?"
"I don't care how powerful he is. He is causing too much trouble on Earth. Gather some troops, and go down to the Fruit and Flower Mountain. I want Sun Wukong arrested!"

prompt.en: why did wukong's subjects cheer for him?
prompt.zh: 为什么悟空的臣民为他欢呼？

choices.en: he was invited to live in heaven.

answer_evidence.quote: Wukong was telling his subjects about his adventure in the Land of Darkness.
"After I crossed out my name," he said, "I crossed out all of your names too. We will all live forever!"

prompt.en: what was wukong put in charge of?

answer_evidence.quote: "Invite Wukong to come to live in Heaven. He will be in charge of the Royal Peach Garden."
"I'm putting you in charge of the Royal Peach Garden. You will have a home here in Heaven. I hope you won't cause any more trouble."

prompt.en: how long does it take the peaches to become ripe?

answer_evidence.quote: The next morning a gardener showed Wukong the peach garden.
Bright, glowing peaches hung from every branch.
"The peaches in this garden are not like peaches on Earth," said the gardener.
"These peaches take thousands of years to become ripe. Anybody who takes a bite of one will live forever."
